label: Bible Study
prompt: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have _____ the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
verse: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
note: Job in the dark, still holding on — God's words mattered more to him than his next meal.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his _____, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.
verse: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.
note: Through the wilderness God carried Israel 'as a man doth bear his son' — every step of the way.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Prove thy servants, I beseech thee, ten days; and let them give us _____ to eat, and water to drink.
verse: Prove thy servants, I beseech thee, ten days; and let them give us pulse to eat, and water to drink.
note: 'Pulse' means vegetables — Daniel's ten-day veggie challenge against the king's rich menu.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his _____ turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as was the heart of David his father.
verse: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as was the heart of David his father.
note: Solomon's foreign wives slowly turned the wisest king's heart to their gods.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is _____.
verse: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.
note: After wrestling till daybreak, Jacob limped away amazed: he had seen God face to face, and his life was 'preserved.'
